title: Crispy Duck Skewers with Pineapple Salsa
description: A twist on traditional Mexican street food, these crispy duck skewers are served with a sweet and tangy pineapple salsa.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the sliced onions and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, thread the duck onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the duck for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
6. In a separate bowl, combine pineapple, red bell pepper, and jalapeno pepper.
7. Once the duck is cooked, brush it with a little olive oil and serve with the pineapple salsa.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
